title: Empirical Finance, Reproduced
text:
Preface
This site is my chapter-by-chapter reproduction of the Lecture Notes for Empirical Finance (Lecture Notes for Empirical Finance, n.d.). Each page follows the structure of the notes and holds my own derivations, code, and results. Read the original notes here.

title: Empirical Finance, Reproduced
text:
How to build
uv sync                 # install Python and the dependencies
uv run quarto preview   # live preview while writing
uv run quarto render    # full build into _book/
Code runs only on my machine. Quarto saves the outputs in _freeze/, which is committed, so GitHub Actions can publish the site without Python or data.

title: Empirical Finance, Reproduced
text:
Conventions
Label equations so other pages can refer to them. For example, a GMM estimator minimizes a quadratic form in the sample moments:
\[
\hat\theta = \arg\min_\theta \; g_T(\theta)' \, W_T \, g_T(\theta),
\qquad
g_T(\theta) = \frac{1}{T} \sum_{t=1}^{T} f(x_t, \theta).
\tag{1}\]
A reference to Equation 1 becomes a link. Shared code lives in src/gmm/ and is imported like any package:

import gmm

print(gmm.__version__)

0.1.0






Lecture Notes for Empirical Finance. n.d. http://efinance.org.cn/cn/AP/lecture%20notes%20for%20empirical%20finance.pdf.
